name: DeLaurenti Garlic Butter
description: We know that you can make garlic butter on your own – we also know that you (and we) rarely do. Please, allow us to help. You know the soft pillowy garlic bread wrapped in foil that always ruins whatever meals follows it? Well…now you can have that same great warm garlic bread sensation without all the negative consequences. Spread this butter on your favorite loaf of artisan bread, wrap it in foil and pop it in the oven. Made with 82% butter fat butter, freshly roasted garlic, herbs, a pinch of chili flakes & Parmigiano-Reggiano. Perfect for tossing with fresh pappardelle, on corn on the cob or grilled fish. Also makes a great steak butter!

name: DeLaurenti Truffle Butter
description: This butter is made in the comfort of the DeLaurenti kitchen with 82% butterfat butter, truffle flecks and high quality truffle oil. Mixed, molded and set, it is ready to toss with your fresh pappardelle or dolloped on a bone-in ribeye!

name: A Butter Place Cacio e Pepe Butter
description: The folks behind A Butter Place started making butter as a pandemic hobby, hand-kneading each pound. Their technique is based on the old-time French style. Based in the Greenwood neighborhood of Seattle, their mission is simple: to provide high-quality, flavorful butter made from locally sourced Cream from Washington Jersey cows, enriched with real, local ingredients. With black pepper, Parmigiano-Reggiano & subtle lemon zest, their Cacio e Pepe compound butter is perfect for finishing a steak or topping grilled vegetables. You're just minutes away from sophisticated butter noodles!

name: A Butter Place Salted Bulk Butter
description: The folks behind A Butter Place started making butter as a pandemic hobby, hand-kneading each pound. Their technique is based on the old-time French style. Based in the Greenwood neighborhood of Seattle, their mission is simple: to provide high-quality, flavorful butter made from locally sourced Cream from Washington Jersey cows, enriched with real, local ingredients. Their salted bulk butter is perfect on a crusty loaf of bread!

name: A Butter Place Unsalted Bulk Butter
description: The folks behind A Butter Place started making butter as a pandemic hobby, hand-kneading each pound. Their technique is based on the old-time French style. Based in the Greenwood neighborhood of Seattle, their mission is simple: to provide high-quality, flavorful butter made from locally sourced Cream from Washington Jersey cows, enriched with real, local ingredients. Their unsalted bulk butter will take your baking to the next level!

name: Beillevaire Seaweed Butter, 125g
description: Pascal Beillevaire, renowned French affineur, doesn't stop at making cheese. His butter is the same as his cheese...amazing. It is made using pasteurized cow's milk, churned and shaped in wooden molds with flakes of seaweed. Perfect for pairing with seafood!

name: Belgioioso Mascarpone, 16oz
description: In 1990, Belgioso became the first American company to start making Italian-style mascarpone. They got it right. This is your key ingredient for your famous tiramisu, Also fantastic with a myriad of other desserts and atop fresh berries!

name: Beurre de Barrate Fleur de Sel, 250g
description:
If you are looking for the butter wrapped in gold foil, this is it! We are now stocking beurre de baratte directly from Fromagerie Réo in Normandy, France. Founded in 1931 by cheesemaker Théodore Réaux, Fromagerie Réo is one of the few remaining producers of traditional beurre de baratte. Located in Lessay, Manche, the dairy is committed to supporting the local economy and promoting sustainable practices. It sources milk from approximately forty producers located within a 30 km radius of the facility. Since 2016, Réo has been part of the Les Maîtres Laitiers du Cotentin group. Réo’s beurre de baratte is manually molded and offered under the brand Le Gaslonde. Made from local pasteurized cream, fleur de sel from Île de Ré, and cultures, the butter naturally varies in color throughout the year—from a deep yellow in spring, due to chlorophyll and beta-carotene in fresh grass, to a pale ivory in winter.

Long story short... Rodolphe le Meunier buys the beurre de baratte directly from Fromagerie Réo and wraps it in that distinctive gold packaging. Le Gaslonde beurre de baratte is 100% exactly the same product as the gold foil version—same producer, ingredients, size, etc.

name: Buji Brown Butter Stick
description: Buji Brown Butter was born from Lisa Herlinger’s passion for transforming simple ingredients into deep, complex flavors. Carefully crafted by cooking down grassfed salted butter and browning the milk solids to perfection, Buji Brown Butter is an excellent addition to your kitchen. Buji’s rich, nutty aroma, smooth texture and depth of flavor will leave a lasting impression on everyone who tastes it. Buji Brown Butter shines at breakfast served with oatmeal, French toast, or used to cook eggs. It elevates your dinner as a finishing butter on grilled or roasted meats and veggies. Not to mention all of its potential uses in baking! The possibilities are endless!

name: Burro di Panna Acidificata, 4oz
description: Discover a butter unlike any other, where tradition meets extraordinary flavor and texture. Guffanti's rich and intense cow's milk butter owes its unique personality—a very light and pleasant acidity—to an all-natural "secret": the acidification of the cream. They use the microorganisms naturally present in fresh cream to initiate a slow and controlled fermentation. The result? A butter with rich aromas and intense flavor and an incredibly creamy texture, perfect at any time of the day, from early morning to a gourmet snack. Magnificent on toast with anchovies for a bold and sophisticated contrast, or paired with jams and compotes to enhance their sweetness.

name: DeLaurenti House Butter
tagline: Fresh bulk butter with course sea salt
description: After a few issues with the FDA, we went looking to replace the French bulk butter we regularly had in the deli. For the life of us, we couldn't find something that had both the quality & the large sea salt crystals that we were after. Turns out, it was right in our back yard the whole time. Our friends at Cherry Valley Dairy in Duvall were kind enough to combine our favorite bulk fleur de sel with their amazing butter and voila! We had it! Made from the milk of their Jersey cows, it is silky, smooth & creamy with an occasional crunch from the course sea salt. Serve it like cheese, your friends will think it's the most buttery cheese they've ever had.

name: Delitia Water Buffalo Milk Whey Butter, 8oz
description: Water Buffalo Milk Whey Butter is a luxurious, creamy butter made from the milk of water buffaloes. Renowned for its rich and slightly tangy flavor, it's a gourmet alternative to traditional cow's milk butter. This artisanal butter is characterized by a smooth texture and a deeper, more complex taste profile, making it a favorite among chefs for its ability to elevate the flavors in a variety of dishes. It tastes best when consumed plain, on rustic bread or seasonal vegetables while remaining an ideal ingredient in cakes or custards.

name: Fatworks Chicken Fat Organic Cooking Oil, 212g
description: Nothing really compares to organic Chicken Fat Schmaltz. It has the richness of duck fat but with a milder and more aromatic flavor. Schmaltz adds complexity to a variety of dishes that you simply cannot reproduce any other way. Schmaltz is a joy to cook with and is the easiest way to add depth and complexity to leafy vegetables, stir-fries, pan-fried steaks, fish, poultry, soups, stews, baked goods, and for a special treat spread it right on a piece of bread like you would a high-quality butter or fine olive oil. It's no exaggeration to say Schmaltz gives potatoes and other root vegetables a flavor that is beyond anything most of us have experienced. If potatoes could talk to schmaltz they would say, "You complete me!" Fatworks Chicken Schmaltz is made with 100% Organic Free Range Chicken and is rendered with the typical care and passion that you would expect from Fatworks.

name: Fatworks Leaf Lard Cooking Oil, 396g
description:
The finest Pasture Raised Leaf Lard available. The gourmet baker's secret weapon. The perfect gateway fat for those who don't want too much pork flavor in their lard. Rendered from the prized pasture-raised "leaf" (internal fat) making it less "porky" tasting than our other lard offering which comes from back fat.

Both have their uses but as there is no meat muscle in the leaf, this lard has a milder pork flavor. This makes for an amazing cooking fat that is delicate, light and "clean" tasting. Bakers have cherished Pasture Raised Leaf Lard because it creates the best crusts and cakes while not imparting any flavor of its own. And because of its high smoke point, Fatworks Pastured Raised Leaf Lard is simply perfect for frying and sautéing, especially when you want the natural flavors of your ingredients to shine. Fatworks Pure Premium Pasture Raised Leaf Lard is essential for anyone interested in cooking with traditional fat. They source the fat from small family farms in the US.

name: Fatworks Traditional Ghee, Cultured Clarified Butter, 212g
description: Let's give some clarity to this clarified butter thing...if it's not cultured, it's not traditional ghee. Fatworks is sure that there are those who wish to debate this, but traditional ghee IS indeed cultured. That's why they insist on sourcing cultured, organic grass-fed butter from domestic family farms. Fatworks experimented with less expensive organic butters from New Zealand and Europe but found that nothing came close to the butter they could source right here in the USA. Fatworks Traditional Ghee is small-batch cooked and roasted to spoon-licking perfection. Use it as you would butter or other cooking oils. Try our Ghee in baking, in a skillet or from the spoon. Also good in smoothies and even coffee to give you clean fat fuel for the day. Their grass fed cow ghee is sourced from 100% Organic butter, is Keto and Paleo friendly as well as being Lactose and Casein Free. So, step right up and get your Vitamin B12, Vitamin A, Vitamin E, Vitamin D, CLA, MCT and Omega 3s. The smoke point is over 480? so this Ghee is great for high heat cooking!

name: Isigny Beurre de Baratte, 250g
description: Isigny Ste Mere's creamy, yellow-hued butter has a distinct caramelized and nutty flavor, made using traditional Baratte method in Normandy, France. Churned and formed by hand, it has just the right amount of salt. Perfect for toast, croissants, scones and more.

name: Le Gall Demi-Sel Butter, 250g
description: This staff favorite is made in Brittany, France, a marshy region so famous for its butter that it was historically exempt from the salt tax! Produced with fresh cream and fermented using traditional methods, this butter is a game changer. Layers of distinct, rich flavor border on cheese-like qualities. Oh, and the texture. Impossibly smooth and creamy with a minimum of 82% butter fat. Yup, I said it...let's not pretend here people. Keep this butter at the ready for your favorite warm bread or baguette. The origin of the expression "it's the bread and butter of the operation" comes to mind. Next time you have a few people over, put it out as the "cheese" course and don't tell anyone. Sorry...and you're welcome!

description: This staff favorite is made in Brittany, France, a marshy region so famous for its butter that it was historically exempt from the salt tax! Produced with fresh cream and fermented using traditional methods, this butter is a game changer. Layers of distinct, rich flavor border on cheese-like qualities. Oh, and the texture. Impossibly smooth and creamy with a minimum of 82% butter fat. Yup, I said it...let's not pretend here people. Keep this butter at the ready for your favorite warm bread or baguette. The bakers on our staff LOVE using this butter to make the most delightfully tender cakes!

name: Les Pres Sale Butter, 8.8oz
description: Stroopwaffles, beer, cycling, and...this butter. Just a few of the great things about Belgium. Churned to a creamy, lush 82% butterfat and flecked with coarse sea salt from Camargue, all that is missing is your favorite loaf of bread.

name: Little Island Creamery Butter, 8oz
description: Located on Puget Island in the Columbia River at Cathlamet, WA, Little Island Creamery is a 54 acre farm comprised of a barn, built in 1946, some out buildings and beautiful pastures. They raise and milk purebred Jersey cows whose milk is high in butter fat, which makes the best cheese, butter and curds anywhere! They love their cows and the love comes through! This butter is the real deal...rich, ultra-creamy and beyond flavorful!

name: Payson Breton Butter, 250g
description: This might be our customer's favorite butter. Commonly known as "the one in the blue checked wrapper," it is impossibly creamy and flecked with crunchy flecks of sea salt. This is not your cooking butter, this is your eating butter. Option 1: Baguette, butter, wine. Option 2: Baguette, butter, honey, coffee.

name: Plugra Salted Butter, 8oz
description: Plugrá uses specially selected cream with just the right amount of butterfat to produce the highest-quality European Style Butter. If you want to make great pastry, enrich sauces, or simply enjoy a piece of bread, this will help. Lightly salted & ready to go in a 1/2 pound block.

name: Sterilgarda Panna da Cucina, 200ml
description: Panna da Cucina by Sterilgarda is the go-to cooking cream in Italian households. Silky, rich, and perfectly balanced for both savory and sweet recipes. From a classic pasta al salmone to a velvety mushroom risotto or a simple panna cotta, this is the cream that makes it all.
